text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you, I'm Royce and Royce. My 
only goal is the title of "The Strongest." 
Though to me, that doesn't just mean raw 
power.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Beloved by the fans, weaving a drama that 
will be told for generations to come—that 
is what it means to be the 'strongest'!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's begin producing you into the 
super-strong, universally loved 
Royce-chan!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
